=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1022]] is assessed at 58% (possible). George’s 1851 household stood beside John-1022’s Glenleslie family, and his c 1815 birth fits John’s older children. Shared locality, a specific adjacent household and compatible generations support John as the leading father candidate. The census gives no parent or sibling clause joining them.

Possible 58%; adjacency is context, and the women named Mary in the two households are not equated.

Next useful test: Seek George’s marriage or a named sibling among the neighbouring family.
